summary: The University of Geneva's Faculty of Science gives Excellence Master Fellowships of CHF 10,000 to 15,000 a year to outstanding students starting a Master of Science in astronomy, biology, chemistry and biochemistry, computer science, mathematics, physics, pharmaceutical sciences or earth sciences. A fellowship is awarded for one year and extended for the normal length of the master's if you do well in your first semester. Applications open each January; the 2027 deadline is not announced yet.
meta_title: University of Geneva Excellence Master Fellowships: CHF 10,000–15,000
meta_description: UNIGE's Faculty of Science pays CHF 10,000 to 15,000 a year to top master's students from any university. Who can apply, documents and dates.
covers: CHF 10,000 to 15,000 a year, with no teaching duties.
Awarded for one year and extended for the regular length of the master's (three or four semesters) if your first-semester results are good.
eligibility: Outstanding students from any university who are among the best in their year, with a finished or nearly finished bachelor's degree.
You must meet the admission criteria of the Faculty of Science master's you choose.
Students who have already started a master's in the Faculty cannot apply.
how_to_apply: Register for your chosen master's on the Admissions Office website first, and keep the 'UNIGE-Candidature' email as proof.
From early January, register for the fellowship online and follow the personal link sent to you by email.
Upload one PDF with the documents below, in English or French.
Meet the deadline published for the year; in 2026 it was 28 February.
watch_out: The 2027 deadline is not announced yet; the 2026 round closed on 28 February 2026.
The grant alone may not cover living costs in Geneva, so plan for the rest.
Some programmes are taught partly in French; check each master's language.
costs: You, helped by CHF 10,000 to 15,000 a year
You (the fellowship page does not say they are waived)
documents: A scan of your passport or national ID
A CV of up to 2 pages
A motivation letter on your scientific interests
Optional: GRE, TOEFL or other test results

faq.q: How much is the UNIGE Excellence Master Fellowship?
faq.a: CHF 10,000 to 15,000 a year, for the regular length of the master's if you succeed in your first semester.
Yes. It is open to outstanding students whatever their home university.
The 2027 date is not announced yet. Applications open in early January; the 2026 deadline was 28 February 2026.
